queries.query: large language model network configuration generation OR "intent to config" "network configuration"
queries.rationale: Locate primary studies where LLMs or generative models are used to produce router/switch/firewall configurations or translate operator intent to configs.
Find analyses of hallucination phenomena specifically in operational/NetOps contexts and examples of incorrect but plausible outputs affecting systems.

queries.query: generate-validate-repair loop LLM "network configuration" OR "generate validate repair"
queries.rationale: Survey architectures combining LLM generation with deterministic validators or repair modules applied to NetOps artifacts.

queries.query: formal verification network configurations OR "reachability" "verification" Batfish Veriflow NetPlumber
queries.rationale: Collect classical deterministic verification methods for network configs to use as validators or oracles in hybrid LLM+validator systems.
Identify methods where LLMs call external tools (simulators, validators, CLI) and use feedback to correct operational outputs.
source_preferences: industry engineering blogs with reproducible artifacts

queries.query: safety constrained generation network operations OR constrained decoding "network"
queries.rationale: Locate constrained generation techniques (decoding constraints, templates, DSLs) applied to safety-critical operational output.

queries.query: benchmarks AIOps NetOps evaluation OR "AIOps benchmark" "NetOps"
queries.rationale: Find existing benchmarks and datasets for LLM/AIOps evaluation in network operations to assess validity and gaps.

queries.query: validity of LLM benchmarks OR "benchmark validity" "LLM" "operational tasks"
queries.rationale: Locate methodological critiques of LLM benchmarks, especially about external validity, task framing, and metric choice.
source_preferences: Philosophy of science / ML evaluation workshops

queries.query: adversarial perturbation LLM outputs operational tasks OR "adversarial" "network configuration"
queries.rationale: Find work on adversarial inputs or perturbations that cause LLMs or agents to produce unsafe or incorrect operational outputs.

queries.query: metrics for operational correctness network configs OR "semantic correctness" "NetOps"
queries.rationale: Identify quantitative metrics and validation protocols for judging correctness, safety, and reliability of generated NetOps artifacts.

queries.query: human-in-the-loop vs autonomous NetOps evaluation OR "human operator" "LLM" "NetOps"
queries.rationale: Compare studies on operator augmentation, human oversight, and full automation trade-offs in network management with generative models.

queries.query: agentic AI for operations OR autonomous agents for NetOps "agent"
queries.rationale: Survey agentic workflows, orchestration frameworks, and safety controls designed for autonomous operational agents in infrastructure domains.

queries.query: case studies LLM errors causing outages OR "configuration error" "outage" "automation"
queries.rationale: Search for empirical or forensic analyses where automated configuration changes caused incidents, to ground failure-mode taxonomy.

queries.query: simulation environments for NetOps testing OR "network simulator" "testbed" automation
queries.rationale: Identify simulators/testbeds (Mininet, ns-3, emulators, vendor sandboxes) suitable for reproducible evaluation of generated configs and change plans.

queries.query: taxonomies of failure modes LLMs OR "failure modes" "LLM" "systems"
queries.rationale: Gather literature on categorizing LLM/system failures to inform experiment design and analysis (e.g., omission, hallucination, format errors, semantic violations).

queries.query: explainability and provenance for generated configs OR "provenance" "LLM" "system changes"
queries.rationale: Find methods to provide interpretable justifications or provenance metadata for generated operational actions to aid validation and auditing.

inclusion_criteria: Works (papers, tool papers, datasets, reproducible code) in English from 2018–2026, prioritizing 2020–2026
Studies applying generative models/LLMs, agentic systems, or AIOps techniques to network operations, configuration generation, change planning, or operational workflows
Deterministic validators, formal verification, or network-analysis tools (Batfish, Veriflow, NetPlumber) used as validators/oracles
Generate–validate–repair, tool-assisted LLM correction, or constrained-generation methods with empirical evaluation
Benchmarks, datasets, or testbeds for NetOps/AIOps with documentation or public artifacts
Incident/postmortem reports and empirical case studies that illustrate operational failure modes
Methodological critiques of benchmark validity, metric suitability, and external validity for operational tasks
Security/adversarial analyses that affect operational outputs
Works providing metrics, taxonomies, or failure-mode analyses relevant to operational correctness, safety, or trustworthiness
Open-source implementations or reproducible artifact availability preferred
exclusion_criteria: Papers solely about general NLP tasks with no linkage to operational or NetOps tasks (e.g., generic summarization or translation without operational framing)
Non-verified informal blog posts or marketing materials without reproducible artifacts or citations (unless from recognized research groups and providing evidence)
Works older than 2018 unless seminal and directly relevant to network verification (allowed selectively)
Purely theoretical LLM research with no evaluation on operational outputs or no applicability to NetOps
Proprietary internal reports inaccessible for verification
Benchmarks that only measure surface language metrics (perplexity/BLEU) without operational correctness/ecosystem validation
date_rationale: Transformers and modern LLM capabilities matured after 2017–2018; include 2018–2026 to capture foundational network-verification work (pre-LLM) and the rapid LLM-era advances. Prioritize 2020–2026 (and especially 2023–2026) because tool-augmented LLMs, agentic systems, and AIOps benchmarks accelerated in this window; include earlier seminal verification papers selectively for validator baselines.
